entry.name: allow-internet-to-web
entry.description: Allow HTTP/HTTPS from internet to DMZ web servers only

entry.name: CRITICAL-rdp-internet-exposed
entry.description: CRITICAL RISK: RDP 3389 open to entire internet. CVE-2019-0708 BlueKeep. No logging enabled. Attacker can reach all internal systems.

entry.name: CRITICAL-internet-to-database-direct
entry.description: CRITICAL: MySQL 3306 directly accessible from internet. Crown jewel asset exposed. Customer data at risk. PCI DSS violation.

entry.name: RISK-cleartext-protocols-allowed
entry.description: RISK: Telnet and FTP cleartext protocols allowed. Credentials transmitted in plaintext. Should be replaced with SSH and SFTP.

entry.name: RISK-overly-permissive-any-any
entry.description: RISK: Any source, any destination, any port, any application, no logging. Maximally permissive rule violating least privilege principle.

entry.name: SHADOWED-deny-internal-to-web
entry.description: SHADOWED: This deny rule is completely ineffective. Rule 6 above matches the same traffic first. This rule never fires.

entry.name: STALE-old-vendor-access
entry.description: STALE: Vendor maintenance access for TechCorp. Last hit 180 days ago. Vendor contract expired. Should be removed immediately.

entry.name: EXPIRED-contractor-access
entry.description: EXPIRED SCHEDULE: Q1 2024 contractor access. Schedule expired March 2024 but rule still exists. Should be deleted.

entry.name: RISK-smb-unrestricted-internal
entry.description: RISK: SMB 445 unrestricted between all internal hosts. CVE-2017-0144 EternalBlue - WannaCry ransomware vector. Critical lateral movement risk.

vulnerability.description: EternalBlue - MS17-010 SMB Remote Code Execution

entry.name: CRITICAL-guest-reaches-internal
entry.description: CRITICAL: Guest WiFi network has unrestricted access to internal corporate network. Zone isolation completely broken. Any visitor on WiFi can reach crown jewel assets.

entry.name: RISK-iot-to-internal
entry.description: RISK: IoT devices can reach internal network. IoT devices frequently unpatched and vulnerable. Compromised camera or printer becomes internal pivot point.

entry.name: CRITICAL-scada-internet-exposure
entry.description: CRITICAL NATIONAL SECURITY RISK: Industrial SCADA PLC controller directly accessible from internet via Modbus and S7comm. No authentication. Physical damage to infrastructure possible. Report to CERT-In immediately.

vulnerability.description: Unauthenticated access to industrial control system

entry.name: dmz-to-database-pivot
entry.description: DMZ web servers to database backend. If web server compromised, attacker reaches ALL databases. Should be source-restricted to specific web server IPs only.

entry.name: CRITICAL-mongodb-internet
entry.description: CRITICAL: MongoDB 27017 internet exposed. No authentication by default. Analytics data including user profiles at risk. Thousands of databases compromised globally via this misconfiguration.

entry.name: REDUNDANT-duplicate-web-rule
entry.description: REDUNDANT: Exact duplicate of allow-internet-to-web rule. Serves no purpose. Creates confusion during audits. Should be removed.

entry.name: CRITICAL-docker-daemon-exposed
entry.description: CRITICAL: Docker daemon port 2375 exposed to internet WITHOUT TLS. Unauthenticated. Attacker can run arbitrary containers, escape to host, pivot to entire dev network, access secrets and source code.

entry.name: CRITICAL-kubernetes-api-exposed
entry.description: CRITICAL: Kubernetes API server port 6443 internet accessible. Attacker can deploy malicious workloads, access all secrets, move to production if namespaces are misconfigured.

entry.name: DISABLED-old-partner-vpn
entry.description: DISABLED: Old partner ABC Corp VPN access rule. Partnership ended 2024. Rule disabled but not removed. Should be deleted to reduce clutter.

entry.name: CRITICAL-pci-violation-dev-to-cde
entry.description: CRITICAL PCI DSS VIOLATION: Development network has direct access to PCI CDE payment gateway. PCI DSS Requirement 1.3 violation. Immediate audit finding. Can result in loss of card processing ability.

entry.name: RISK-c2-ports-allowed-outbound
entry.description: CRITICAL: Known C2 framework ports 4444 (Metasploit) and 50050 (Cobalt Strike) allowed outbound. If any internal host is infected with malware using these ports, it can communicate freely with attacker C2 servers.

entry.name: RISK-ssh-management-internet
entry.description: RISK: SSH management access allowed from entire internet to management zone. Should be restricted to specific admin IP ranges or VPN only. Exposed to automated SSH brute force attacks 24/7.

entry.name: branch-vpn-overly-broad
entry.description: RISK: Branch office has unrestricted access to entire internal network via VPN. If branch office is compromised, attacker has full access to headquarters. Should follow least privilege.

entry.name: RISK-dns-open-resolver
entry.description: RISK: Open DNS resolver accessible from internet. Can be used as amplification vector for DDoS attacks against third parties. Your infrastructure becomes part of an attack. UDP amplification factor up to 70x.

entry.name: allow-supplier-portal-business-hours
entry.description: Supplier portal access restricted to business hours only. Source: Supplier XYZ Ltd office range.

entry.name: RISK-snmp-internet-exposed
entry.description: RISK: SNMP accessible from internet. SNMPv1/v2 uses cleartext community strings (often public/private). Attacker can read entire network topology, ARP tables, routing tables, and potentially write configs.

entry.name: allow-employee-vpn
entry.description: Allow employee IPSec VPN connections to VPN concentrator only. Properly scoped to specific destination.

entry.name: CRITICAL-bigdata-internet-exposed
entry.description: CRITICAL: Redis 6379, Kafka 9092, ZooKeeper 2181, Elasticsearch 9200 all internet exposed. All have no authentication by default. Full data access, potential RCE via Redis SLAVEOF, Kafka consumer group manipulation.
